channel.title: Projects on IoTone, Inc.
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on IoTone, Inc.

item.title: Spectacles-polynode
item.description: The ‘missing’ web utility/core libraries for Snap Spectacles — SpaceCanvas, SpaceSVG, SpaceDOM, EventEmitter — backfills HTML5 platform APIs Lens Studio doesn’t ship.

item.title: Project MAG*Net
item.description: Distributed IoT data sync & control across Matter, Zigbee, Thread, HomeKit, BLE, and Wi-Fi. ESP32 firmware + C++ runtime.

item.title: Burisu (ブライス)
item.description: A browser-native remake of the classic KPT Bryce 3D landscape generator — Rust compiled to WASM, rendered with WebGPU, tuned to run on a 4GB Raspberry Pi 5.

item.title: Spectacles SkywriterBLE
item.description: BLE HID keyboard for Snap Spectacles, with a distraction-free XR word processor on top. 3rd Place OSS Prize, Lensfest April 2026.

item.title: MIDI Bleep Blop
item.description: A MIDI library and bridge that turns a Snap Spectacles lens into a controller for real hardware synths. #Lensfest May 2026 OSS, with a Tester Lens.

item.title: Spectacles NekoChan
item.description: A fully on-device Snap Spectacles lens: a 3D cat that shares facts — in Japanese — about native breeds and Japan’s cat islands. No internet, no experimental APIs.

item.title: gsplats to WebXR
item.description: A minimal starter for getting Gaussian splats into WebXR — Spark rendering 3DGS over Three.js, served over HTTPS so it drops straight into a headset.

item.title: BowleraramaXR (Godot)
item.description: A synthwave-themed bowling alley and a working Godot XR starter for Android XR and Meta Quest 3 — with the build steps that the official docs skip.

item.title: Spectacles-Matematex
item.description: A LaTex parser and renderer for Snap Spectacles, for rendering math notation in AR.

item.title: Spectacles DeskWindow
item.description: Spatial desktop mirroring for Snap Spectacles — the first OSS solution for streaming a desktop into AR.

item.title: MusicPixels (Cardputer ADV)
item.description: A generative analog-style synthesizer for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV, with audio-reactive geometry drawn on a transparent M5 Unit Glass OLED. Out of the Fukuoka hacking scene.

item.title: offlinesns (Meshtastic Japan)
item.description: Community initiative bringing Meshtastic to Japan, started in Fukuoka. LoRa, Rust, and off-grid social.

item.title: RockeTone
item.description: IoT-instrumented papercraft and model rockets, run out of IoTone Japan. プロジェクトは紙飛行機と小型ロケットをIOTによって最新化する。

item.title: Shashin GO
item.description: Open-source DIY wearable AI camera. Concept 1 + 2 hardware design files. Privacy-first capture.

item.title: OpenWR
item.description: An open-hardware reference platform for wearable IoT.

item.title: Snap Spectacles Interaction Kit Samples
item.description: Snap Spectacles Interaction Kit Samples designed as a building block for new lenses.

item.title: Industrial IoT / VR consulting
item.description: IoT protocol expertise across the device → mobile → cloud stack, in conjunction with VR digital-twin builds for industrial customers.

item.title: NFTYGlobe
item.description: An NFC-based 3D NFT viewer for OpenSea — hardware + software prototype.

item.title: Blockchain-In-A-Box
item.description: A rapid-prototyping kit for enterprise blockchain solutions and Industrial / IoT blockchain dapps.

item.title: IoToneKit
item.description: An all-in-one starter kit for low-cost MPU-based IoT solutions on ARMv5 / ARMv7 Linux, with MFi and Zigbee integration.

item.title: FootTrackr
item.description: Privacy-respecting RFID-based foot-traffic tracking for events and retail. Zero enrollment.
